title: fynkel.Animator
description: Plays one clip over the entity's subtree (M3-19, `docs/animation.md`): every channel of `clip` drives the first descendant (the entity itself included) named like the channel's target, in the pre-tick slot, so physics and the catalogue see the posed transforms this tick. `speed` scales time (negative plays backwards); a `looping` clip wraps, one that is not stops at its last key with `playing` cleared and an `ANIMATION_ENDED` event. `Command::Animate` plays, crossfades, stops, pauses, resumes, re-speeds and seeks it from Dart; the world must know the clip (`World::register_clip`; the loaders register every clip a loaded scene's animators name, `CLIP_UNAVAILABLE` once otherwise).  Layers (M3-19c): a second animator on a descendant is a layer over the first — animators apply ancestor-first, so the deeper one owns the entities its clip names (a mask by placement: an `Animator` on the spine drives the upper body over the one on the root). `weight` blends its pose over what is under it (`0` leaves it untouched), `additive` adds the clip's difference from its first frame instead of replacing the pose (a wave over a walk). `root_motion` takes the planar translation and yaw of the clip's root channel out of the pose and publishes the per-tick delta: a `CharacterController` on the entity walks by it, else the entity's own transform moves.  ADR-0032: with a `controller` (an Animator Controller, `.controller.json`) the animator runs its state machine instead and `clip` and `looping` are not used; `speed`, `playing`, `weight` and `root_motion` still apply to the whole animator.

clip.description: The clip (an imported glTF `anim/<a>` sub-asset or a blend space `.blend.json`); nil plays nothing.

speed.description: Playback rate, `1` is authored speed; finite.

weight.description: Blend weight of this animator's pose over the pose beneath it, in `[0, 1]`; `1` (the default) replaces it.

additive.description: Add the clip's delta from its first frame instead of replacing.

root_motion.description: Extract the root channel's planar motion (see above).

controller.description: The Animator Controller it runs (ADR-0032); none plays `clip`.
